prior_source_documented_design.experiment: 12 artificial saltmarsh islands within one Wadden Sea tidal-flat study region, plus nearby natural saltmarsh plot/control units
prior_source_documented_design.experimental_unit: independently assigned plot / island cage, NOT 10x10cm cell or annual row
prior_source_documented_design.seed_traps: monthly 2020–2021; five transects and 6 distance classes 0/50/100/200/300/500 m from saltmarsh
prior_source_documented_design.life_stage_separation: seed propagule arrival in traps versus rooted plant detection in vegetation plots
ecology_hypotheses: Distance-dependent propagule supply may diverge from subsequent establishment due to flooding elevation and local microsite conditions
Experimental transplanted versus bare patch histories may alter establishment conditional on external propagule availability
Observed rooted 0→1 within a plot is not demonstrated dispersal from a specific donor population
prior_source_documented_design.known_priors: Published 2017 experimental island setup and 2025/2026 data releases exist; must not claim it was a novel experimental island invention

source_semantic_gates: Original five latest files with exact source IDs and version metadata identifiable
Coordinates PlotID, survey Year, Type, Zone, Treatment and seed-trap transect/year station keys must be separately documented
Distinguish experimental 12 island cages from control plots and repeated 10x10cm subsamples
Don't interpret annual plant observation as direct natally identified seed immigration
Do not conflate 2020–21 seed traps with 2014–23 plot observations without explicit spatial and time crosswalk
Single original Wadden Sea experiment is ONE independent landscape, not 12 independent archipelagos
output_only: source version, exact file IDs, names, checksums, sizes, source status and anti-pseudoreplication design decision
